column1: # Rows db.etos.* (line RG, X-etos-owner): BLASTN's cutoff of an e-value whose quotient K*searchsp/E passes the range of a double (blast_stat.c:4059-4061): on x86-64 NCBI's conversion to Int4 gives INT_MIN, so `BLAST_Cutoffs` keeps the cutoff 1 and the word cutoff (the smallest of the ungapped cutoff, the gap trigger and the hit-saving cutoff) is 1: every seed is extended. tests/fasta/etos/gq.fna and gs.fna: one alignment of 150 runs of 11 matches, each followed in the subject by one inserted base (bases that never repeat, so each run's ungapped extension stops at 22, below the gap trigger's 29). With -searchsp 2^63-1 and -evalue 1e-300 NCBI 2.17.0 writes it (score 2258); with -evalue 1e-200 the quotient is finite, the word cutoff is 29 and NCBI writes nothing. LOSAT's BLASTN keeps NCBI's conversion (`BLASTN_CUTOFF_CONVERSION`); the other programs take the finite value of PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS exception 8 (Owner question Q-ETOS8).

column12: X-etos-owner: the quotient past the double, word cutoff 1: the alignment of 150 gapped runs found
X-etos-owner: a finite quotient, word cutoff 29: no seed extended, no alignment
